JOYSTAR Miss Berry Kids Bike - 10" - 16" for Ages 1-7
Introduce your little one to the joy of riding with the JOYSTAR Miss Berry. Designed specifically for toddlers, this bike combines a charming vintage look with beginner-friendly features to make their first cycling experience safe, stable, and unforgettable.

Perfect for early learners: The Miss Berry Kids Bike with Push Handle.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"The Miss Berry isn't just a bike; it's a teaching tool. The parent handle provides peace of mind while the puncture-proof tires ensure a smooth, worry-free lesson every time."
Guidance and Stability
Safety starts with control. The Miss Berry's parent push handle allows you to manage steering and balance without bending over, preventing back strain while keeping your child safe. Combined with a sturdy steel frame and enclosed chain guard, this bike provides a secure environment for your toddler to explore their surroundings.
Built for Total Safety
The JOYSTAR Miss Berry is constructed with a durable steel frame that provides a solid foundation for toddlers. Safety is paramount, which is why it includes a fully enclosed chain guard to protect small fingers and prevent clothing entanglement. The non-slip plastic pedals further enhance stability, ensuring your child stays firmly in control.

Perfect for early learners: The Miss Berry in Mint Green.

Key Features & Benefits

Maintenance-Free Tires: Equipped with EVA polymer foam tires that are puncture-proof and never need air.

Growth-Friendly: Features an adjustable seat post to keep up with your toddler's growth.

Beginner Stability: Comes standard with heavy-duty training wheels to help build confidence and balance.

Complete Package: Includes fun accessories like a front woven basket, a classic bell, and DIY decals.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Spend less time building and more time riding. The JOYSTAR Miss Berry arrives 85% pre-assembled. With the included tools and clear instructions, you can have the seat, front tire, and training wheels installed in about 25 minutes.

Assembly Guide: Get your Miss Berry ready for the sidewalk in minutes.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

Explore Every Detail
Get a close-up look at the craftsmanship and safety features of the JOYSTAR New Berry. This video highlights the reinforced frame, precision braking system, and the premium finish that sets our bikes apart.

Detailed Walkthrough: A closer look at the New Berry's engineering and design.

Our Guarantee
We stand behind the quality of our bikes so you can shop with confidence:

Lifetime Warranty: Covered on all metal frames, rigid forks, stems, and handlebars against manufacturing defects.

Fast Shipping: Most orders process within 48 hours via trusted carriers like UPS and FedEx.
